:::{#def-linf-function-space}
#### $\mathcal{L}^\infty$ space ($\mathcal{L}^\infty(S, \salg, \measure)$)

Let $(S, \salg, \measure)$ be a [measure space](#def-measure-space).
The **$\mathcal{L}^\infty$ space** $\mathcal{L}^\infty(S, \salg, \measure)$
is the [set](sets.qmd#def-set) of all [measurable functions](#def-measurable-function) $f : S \to \reals$
whose [essential supremum norm](#def-essential-supremum-norm) is less than $\infty$:
$\norm{f}_\infty < \infty$.

:::
